faq.question: Is my CSV data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All CSV parsing and JSON conversion happen locally in your browser. Your data is not uploaded to a remote server and does not leave your device.

faq.question: Does it handle quoted fields?
faq.answer: Yes. The converter correctly handles quoted fields, commas inside quotes, newlines within quoted cells, and escaped characters according to common CSV rules.

faq.question: Can I convert large CSV files?
faq.answer: You can convert larger CSV files as long as they can be loaded and processed by your browser. The practical limit depends on available memory, device performance, and the complexity of the data.

faq.question: What format does the JSON output use?
faq.answer: The output is a JSON array of objects. Each CSV row becomes one object, and the column headers (or generated keys if no header) become the property names.

faq.question: Does it support different delimiters?
faq.answer: Yes. You can choose comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, or let the tool auto-detect the delimiter based on the input content.

faq.question: Does it infer data types?
faq.answer: Yes. When type inference is enabled, numeric strings are converted to numbers, 'true' and 'false' (case-insensitive) to booleans, and empty cells to null.

faq.question: What if my CSV has no header row?
faq.answer: If you disable the 'First row is header' option, the converter will generate generic keys such as column0, column1, etc. You can then rename keys in the JSON if needed.

faq.question: Can I use this tool for TSV files?
faq.answer: Yes. TSV (tab-separated values) files are supported. Select the tab delimiter or use auto-detect, then convert the TSV to JSON as usual.

faq.question: Can I convert JSON back to CSV?
faq.answer: This tool focuses on CSV to JSON conversion. For JSON to CSV conversion, use a dedicated JSON to CSV converter tool in the same toolbox.

faq.question: Is this a free CSV to JSON converter?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a free online CSV to JSON converter. You can paste CSV text or upload files, configure options, and export JSON without creating an account or uploading data to a server.

article.title: How to Convert CSV to JSON Online
article.content:
What Is CSV to JSON Conversion?

CSV (Comma-Separated Values) is a simple tabular format widely used for exporting data from spreadsheets, databases, and analytics tools. JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a structured, hierarchical format commonly used in APIs, web applications, and modern data pipelines.

Converting CSV to JSON transforms flat, row-based data into an array of objects, where each row becomes an object and each column becomes a property. This makes the data easier to work with in JavaScript, frontend frameworks, and API-driven workflows.

Why Convert CSV to JSON?

  • API integration: Many APIs expect JSON payloads instead of CSV
  • Frontend development: JSON is the native data format for JavaScript and frameworks like React, Vue, and Angular
  • Data transformation: JSON supports nested structures, making it easier to reshape data for specific use cases
  • Configuration files: JSON is commonly used for application settings and feature flags
  • Programmatic processing: JSON is easier to parse and manipulate in most programming languages

How to Convert CSV to JSON

  1. Paste or upload CSV: Add your CSV content by pasting text or uploading a .csv, .tsv, or .txt file.
  2. Configure options: Select the delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, or auto-detect), indicate whether the first row is a header, and choose JSON indentation.
  3. Enable type inference (optional): If enabled, numeric strings become numbers, 'true'/'false' become booleans, and empty cells become null.
  4. Click Convert: The tool parses the CSV and generates a JSON array of objects.
  5. Copy or download: Copy the JSON to your clipboard or save it as a .json file for use in your project.

Understanding the Output Format

The default output is a JSON array where each CSV row becomes an object. If your CSV has a header row, the header values are used as property names. For example:

name,age,city
Alice,30,New York
Bob,25,London

becomes:

[
  { "name": "Alice", "age": 30, "city": "New York" },
  { "name": "Bob", "age": 25, "city": "London" }
]

If there is no header row, the converter generates generic keys such as column0, column1, etc. You can later rename these keys in the JSON if needed.

Handling Special Cases

  • Quoted fields: The converter correctly handles fields enclosed in quotes, including commas and newlines inside quoted cells.
  • Escaped characters: Common CSV escape sequences and quoted quotes are preserved correctly in the JSON output.
  • Different delimiters: Semicolon-separated, tab-separated (TSV), and pipe-separated files are all supported.
  • Empty cells: Empty values can be converted to null when type inference is enabled, or kept as empty strings if preferred.

Best Practices

  • Use header rows: Including a header row makes the resulting JSON more readable and self-describing.
  • Check data types: Review the output to ensure numbers, booleans, and strings are represented as expected.
  • Validate JSON: After conversion, use a JSON validator to confirm the output is well-formed before using it in production.
  • Keep a backup: Retain the original CSV file in case you need to re-import or adjust the conversion settings.
  • Consider encoding: For non-ASCII characters, ensure your CSV file uses UTF-8 encoding to avoid character issues in the JSON output.

Common Use Cases

  • Spreadsheet exports: Convert Excel or Google Sheets exports into JSON for use in web applications
  • Database dumps: Transform CSV exports from databases into JSON for API consumption
  • Analytics data: Convert analytics or reporting CSVs into JSON for visualization libraries
  • Test data: Generate JSON test fixtures from CSV datasets for automated testing
  • Migration scripts: Prepare data for migration by converting legacy CSV formats to JSON

Client-Side Privacy

This CSV to JSON converter processes input in your browser instead of requiring an upload to a remote service. That can be convenient for internal datasets, sensitive reports, or development data. However, you should still avoid entering passwords, API keys, access tokens, or other highly sensitive information into any browser-based tool.

article.title: 如何在线将 CSV 转换为 JSON
article.content:
什么是 CSV 转 JSON？

CSV（逗号分隔值）是一种简单的表格格式，广泛用于从电子表格、数据库和分析工具导出数据。JSON（JavaScript 对象表示法）是一种结构化的分层格式，常用于 API、Web 应用和现代数据管道。

将 CSV 转换为 JSON，可以把扁平的、按行组织的数据变成一个对象数组：每一行变成一个对象，每一列变成一个属性。这样在 JavaScript、前端框架和基于 API 的工作流中更容易使用。

为什么要将 CSV 转换为 JSON？

  • API 集成：许多 API 期望接收 JSON 载荷而不是 CSV
  • 前端开发：JSON 是 JavaScript 以及 React、Vue、Angular 等框架的原生数据格式
  • 数据转换：JSON 支持嵌套结构，更容易根据具体需求重塑数据
  • 配置文件：JSON 常用于应用设置和功能开关等配置场景
  • 程序化处理：在大多数编程语言中，JSON 比 CSV 更容易解析和操作

如何将 CSV 转换为 JSON

  1. 粘贴或上传 CSV：通过粘贴文本或上传 .csv、.tsv、.txt 文件添加 CSV 内容。
  2. 配置选项：选择分隔符（逗号、分号、制表符、竖线或自动检测），指定第一行是否为表头，并选择 JSON 缩进风格。
  3. 启用类型推断（可选）：启用后，数字字符串会转换为数值，'true'/'false' 会转换为布尔值，空单元格会转换为 null。
  4. 点击转换：工具会解析 CSV 并生成一个 JSON 对象数组。
  5. 复制或下载：将 JSON 复制到剪贴板，或保存为 .json 文件以便在项目中使用。

理解输出格式

默认输出是一个 JSON 数组，其中每一行 CSV 数据变成一个对象。如果 CSV 包含表头行，则表头值会作为属性名。例如：

name,age,city
Alice,30,New York
Bob,25,London

会被转换为：

[
  { "name": "Alice", "age": 30, "city": "New York" },
  { "name": "Bob", "age": 25, "city": "London" }
]

如果没有表头行，转换器会生成通用的键名，如 column0、column1 等。如有需要，之后可以在 JSON 中重命名这些键。

处理特殊情况

  • 带引号的字段：转换器能正确处理被引号包围的字段，包括引号内的逗号和换行。
  • 转义字符：常见的 CSV 转义序列和引号中的引号会在 JSON 输出中正确保留。
  • 不同分隔符：支持分号分隔、制表符分隔（TSV）和竖线分隔的文件。
  • 空单元格：启用类型推断时，空值可以转换为 null；也可以根据需要保留为空字符串。

最佳实践

  • 使用表头行：包含表头行可以让生成的 JSON 更具可读性和自描述性。
  • 检查数据类型：检查输出，确保数字、布尔值和字符串的表示符合预期。
  • 验证 JSON：转换后，使用 JSON 验证工具确认输出格式正确，然后再用于生产环境。
  • 保留备份：保留原始 CSV 文件，以便需要时重新导入或调整转换设置。
  • 注意编码：对于非 ASCII 字符，确保 CSV 文件使用 UTF-8 编码，避免在 JSON 输出中出现字符问题。

常见使用场景

  • 表格导出：将 Excel 或 Google 表格的导出文件转换为 JSON，用于 Web 应用
  • 数据库导出：将数据库的 CSV 导出转换为 JSON，供 API 使用
  • 分析数据：将分析或报表 CSV 转换为 JSON，用于可视化库
  • 测试数据：从 CSV 数据集生成 JSON 测试用例，用于自动化测试
  • 迁移脚本：将旧系统的 CSV 格式数据转换为 JSON，用于数据迁移

浏览器本地处理与隐私

这个 CSV 转 JSON 转换器在浏览器中处理输入内容，不要求将数据上传到远程服务。对于内部数据集、敏感报表或开发数据来说，本地处理更加方便。不过，仍然不建议在任何浏览器工具中输入密码、API 密钥、访问令牌或其他高度敏感的信息。
